note: alone-AUC on FIT+MINE ONLY -- MONITOR and the honest population are never read for a design decision (M3 precedent).

all_channels.name: Professional regulatory drafting
all_channels.instruction: Score how closely the text resembles polished counsel-style regulatory drafting. A 10 has professional organization, precise docket and provision references, issue-by-issue proposed edits, and administrability framing. A 0 is informal, unsystematic, and nontechnical. This scores the drafting register and apparatus as a surface feature, not whether the positions taken are sound.
all_channels.upstream_parent: Law-firm or professional regulatory-affairs drafting resources

all_channels.name: Reads as a graded course assignment rather than a stakeholder filing
all_channels.instruction: Score how closely the comment reads as a graded student writing exercise rather than a stakeholder filing. Marks of a 10: explicit assignment or student framing ('Final Assignment', 'we are masters students at X'); an opening that paraphrases the notice's own background back to the agency before opining; a five-paragraph thesis-and-restatement shape; hedged conviction verbs ('I believe') standing in for evidence; general-audience or commercial pages (law-firm blogs, marketing sites) cited as authority; statistics adjacent to but not about the rule; and no operational detail knowable only from inside the sector. A 5 is essayistic and general but carries one concrete sector-specific fact. A 0 supplies operational, regulatory, or technical detail from direct working knowledge and never gestures at the act of commenting itself.
all_channels.upstream_parent: The comment was produced as a classroom assignment or course exercise rather than by a party with a stake in the rule

all_channels.name: Scanned/faxed physical-document artifacts (OCR noise, stamps)
all_channels.instruction: Score the visible marks that the text originated from a scanned, faxed, or mailed physical document rather than a native digital web-form entry. A 10 shows clear, heavy artifacts of this kind: garbled OCR character strings, broken word-spacing from multi-column layout, date-stamped footers, or 'RECEIVED' or 'POSTMARKED' stamps. A 0 is clean native digital text with no scan or transmission artifacts. This is a surface-format feature; score the artifacts only.
all_channels.upstream_parent: the submission channel/era -- a mailed or faxed physical letter processed into the docket rather than typed directly into an electronic comment form

all_channels.name: Numbered or bulleted list formatting
all_channels.instruction: Score only whether the comment is organised into numbered or bulleted items. A 10 uses numbered or bulleted list markers. A 0 is continuous prose with no list markers. This is a surface-formatting check: never consider the content of the items.
all_channels.upstream_parent: professional drafting / template use

all_channels.name: First-hand local exposure
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the commenter describes a first-hand personal or local stake in the proposal. A 10 describes personal residence, occupation, direct exposure, or concrete local consequences tied to the proposal. A 0 contains no personal or geographically specific stake. Score the presence and concreteness of the stated first-hand connection, not how sympathetic it is.
all_channels.upstream_parent: Submitter's direct personal exposure or local victim status

all_channels.name: OCR and attachment provenance
all_channels.instruction: Score the presence of filing and document-wrapper artifacts in the text. A 10 shows document-wrapper language, duplicated covers, slide or page extraction, OCR corruption, attachment references, or similar filing residue. A 0 is clean native prose without such artifacts. This is a surface-format feature; score the artifacts only, not the substance around them.
all_channels.upstream_parent: professional document production and docket-ingestion pipeline

all_channels.name: Pseudo-quantified authority
all_channels.instruction: Score how much quantified or attributed authority the comment accumulates as rhetorical support. A 10 piles up precise statistics, dollar amounts, percentages, named reports, studies, media links, or numerical forecasts. A 0 contains no quantified or attributed authority at all. This scores the presence and density of such material as it appears in the text, not whether it is accurate or well used.
all_channels.upstream_parent: professional advocacy research and briefing support

all_channels.name: Credentialed insider self-positioning
all_channels.instruction: Score how prominently the author asserts credentialed standing in the regulated field. A 10 prominently states a professional license, a senior role, years of experience, or a close occupational relationship to that field. A 0 asserts no expertise or role. Score the self-positioning as stated in the text, not whether the credential is verified or relevant.
all_channels.upstream_parent: submitter's sector standing or seniority

all_channels.name: Coordinated campaign residue
all_channels.instruction: Score the presence of mass-campaign language in the comment's text. A 10 contains recognizable repeated campaign phrasing, mass-appeal slogans, campaign metadata, or standardized calls to action. A 0 is clearly bespoke prose written for this specific docket. This is a surface textual marker: score the wording only, never the merit or sincerity of the comment.
all_channels.upstream_parent: coordinated advocacy campaign

all_channels.name: Personal anecdote as the sole evidentiary support
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the comment's entire argument rests on first-person anecdote. Score 10 when every supporting claim comes from the writer's own experience (I noticed…, in my case…), with no external citation, data, or source referenced anywhere in the text. Score 0 when the argument is built on external sources, data, regulatory text, or reasoning that does not depend on the writer's personal experience.
all_channels.upstream_parent: individual layperson submitter without institutional or research resources to marshal external evidence

all_channels.name: Agency-relationship disclosure
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the writer discloses a prior or ongoing relationship with the agency. Score 10 when the comment explicitly describes previous permits, recurring meetings, ongoing communications, or past dealings with the agency. Score 0 when no prior agency relationship is mentioned. This is a disclosure feature of the text: score its presence, not whether the relationship lends authority.
all_channels.upstream_parent: existing relationships with agency personnel or programs

all_channels.name: Coalition consensus packaging
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the comment presents itself as speaking for many parties. Score 10 when it claims to represent multiple organizations, a membership, or a consensus process and names those parties. Score 0 when it is clearly an individual submission made on the writer's own behalf. Score the claim as presented in the text; no outside verification is expected.
all_channels.upstream_parent: coordinated organizational mobilization

all_channels.name: Regulatory-lawyer fluency
all_channels.instruction: Score how precisely the comment maps proposed text onto the regulatory apparatus. Score 10 when it ties the proposal to specific docket provisions, CFR sections, statutory authority, or requested edits in the register a regulatory practitioner uses. Score 0 when it offers only broad support or opposition with no such mapping.
all_channels.upstream_parent: professional regulatory counsel or lobbying resources

all_channels.name: Submission-wrapper residue
all_channels.instruction: Score how much submission-wrapper residue the text carries. Score 10 when portal or email headers, attachment placeholders, filenames, OCR errors, duplicated cover text, or page artifacts appear abundantly throughout. Score 0 when the text is clean, direct prose containing none of this material. This is a surface feature of the document: score how much residue is present, nothing else.
all_channels.upstream_parent: surface-only

all_channels.name: Formal salutation and signature block present
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the comment carries formal letter furniture. Score 10 when it opens with a formal salutation (Dear Administrator, To Whom It May Concern) and closes with a signature block naming a person or organisation. Score 0 when neither is present, and an intermediate score when only one is. This is a surface feature of format: score only the salutation and signature block.
all_channels.upstream_parent: professional or organisational correspondence practice

all_channels.name: Institutional credential display
all_channels.instruction: Score how prominently the comment advertises institutional credentials. Score 10 when it foregrounds organizational size, market share, longevity, assets, employees, facilities, or senior titles. Score 0 when no institutional credentials are given. This is a self-presentation feature of the text: score how prominent the display is, not whether the credentials are impressive.
all_channels.upstream_parent: organizational resources and status

all_channels.name: Bare presence of a numeric figure anywhere in the text
all_channels.instruction: Score whether any digit-bearing quantity appears anywhere in the comment. Score 10 when at least one number, percentage, dollar amount, or date written with digits is present. Score 0 when the comment contains no digits at all. This is a surface feature: do not consider what the number is used for or whether it is correct.
all_channels.upstream_parent: surface-only

all_channels.name: Campaign template reuse
all_channels.instruction: Score how strongly the text reads as reproduced from a shared campaign template. Score 10 when the wording, headings, demands, or paragraph order appear duplicated from a circulated form submission, with little individualized content. Score 0 when the wording is clearly original and specific to this writer. This is a surface feature of the wording, scored as such and not as a judgment of quality.
all_channels.upstream_parent: coordinated mass-comment campaign

all_channels.name: Ask serves more than the commenter's own burden or exposure
all_channels.instruction: Score who benefits from the change the comment requests, as the comment itself frames it. 10 = the change would improve the rule's functioning for third parties, the protected resource, or the public, including where it plainly costs the commenter something. 5 = the ask helps the commenter, but the stated reasons are about workability for everyone. 0 = the ask is entirely relief for the submitter (delay, exemption, a higher threshold, more time), and its public-interest framing adds no independent content.

all_channels.name: Embedded formal citation within personal-voice prose
all_channels.instruction: Score whether a formal citation sits embedded inside otherwise personal, informal, first-person prose. 10 = the narrating voice is personal and informal yet carries one or more formal legal or scholarly citations (a full case citation, a parenthetical citation to a named organization, a footnoted source) that read as inserted by another hand, creating a clear register shift. 0 = no such embedded citation appears, or the comment is uniformly formal or uniformly informal with no citations at all.
all_channels.upstream_parent: the comment received legal or research assistance (e.g. an attorney or claims law firm representing a claimant, or a teacher/librarian helping a student) that supplied one or more specific supporting citations without otherwise rewriting the submitter's voice

all_channels.name: Credential and status parade
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the comment's opening prominently parades the writer's status markers. 10 = the opening prominently lists multiple degrees, certifications, fellowships, offices, titles, or years of experience. 0 = no status or expertise signals appear. This is a surface feature: score the display of the markers, not the writer's actual expertise.
all_channels.upstream_parent: Submitter's professional seniority, standing, and access to policymakers

all_channels.name: Emotional advocacy intensity
all_channels.instruction: Score how intense the comment's emotional advocacy register is. 10 = repeated alarm, outrage, moral condemnation, emphatic praise, all-caps, exclamation marks, or vivid metaphors run through the text. 0 = the prose is consistently restrained and neutral. This is a surface feature: score the register, not whether the emotion is warranted.
all_channels.upstream_parent: Advocacy-campaign messaging norms

all_channels.name: NGO action-alert templated phrasing
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the comment uses stock activist phrasing typical of NGO mass-comment action-alert tools. 10 = it strongly exhibits that templated register: formulaic gratitude closings ('THANK YOU for your commitment to...'), superlative-modified positions ('I HIGHLY support...', 'I strongly urge...'), and emphatic capitalized keywords, especially in a short, largely interchangeable one-fact-plus-a-plea structure. 0 = no such stock phrasing appears. This is a surface feature: score the phrasing, not the sincerity behind it.
all_channels.upstream_parent: comment was generated or guided by an NGO/advocacy-group mass-comment campaign tool (e.g. a pre-filled web action alert) that supplies stock phrasing for the submitter to personalize

all_channels.name: Formal itemized technical/regulatory rebuttal structure
all_channels.instruction: Score how far the comment is laid out as a formal point-by-point regulatory rebuttal. 10 = the whole comment is addressed to a named official or office and broken into discrete numbered or lettered items, each citing a specific rule paragraph, CFR subsection, AD or docket number, or service-bulletin reference, with little connective persuasive narrative between points. 0 = it is continuous persuasive prose with no addressee-directed itemized rule-section corrections.
all_channels.upstream_parent: the submitter is a regulated entity's engineering/compliance staff responding to a routine Airworthiness Directive or product-specific technical requirement as an established business process, not an independent stakeholder building a persuasive case

all_channels.name: Professional document apparatus
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the submission carries professional document-production apparatus. 10 = it contains elaborate exhibits, master indexes, slide decks, service-bulletin reproductions, revision histories, or attachment-heavy packaging. 0 = it is a plain standalone comment with no document-production signals. This is a surface feature: score the packaging, not the quality of what is packaged.
all_channels.upstream_parent: Availability of lawyers, engineers, consultants, and professional document-production resources

all_channels.name: Docket number or RIN quoted verbatim
all_channels.instruction: Score whether a docket identifier or RIN appears verbatim in the comment. 10 = such an identifier string is present in the text. 0 = neither a docket number nor a RIN appears. Score only whether the identifier string is present, never whether the comment addresses the right rule.
all_channels.upstream_parent: familiarity with docket conventions

all_channels.name: Agency-relationship cues
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the comment refers to a prior or ongoing relationship with the agency. 10 = it mentions prior meetings, ongoing collaboration, earlier submissions, established partnerships, or direct exchanges with agency personnel. 0 = it carries only a generic salutation and no relationship history. This is a surface feature: score the presence of the cues, not what they imply about the comment's worth.
all_channels.upstream_parent: Existing relationships and insider access within the agency or docket lifecycle

all_channels.name: First-person credential or stake self-disclosure
all_channels.instruction: Score how explicitly and prominently the comment establishes the writer's own identity, credentials, professional role, or stake, as in 'I am a Professor...', 'I have X years of experience...', 'I represent...', or naming a degree, certification, or affiliation. 10 = the comment opens with or centers on an extended personal or professional credential or identity statement. 0 = no self-identifying credential or stake language appears at all. Score the disclosure itself, whether or not that identity is load-bearing for the argument.
all_channels.upstream_parent: submitter's professional standing, expertise, or personal stake in the issue, and an instinct to lead with ethos-establishing credentials

all_channels.name: Emotional-hook opening sentence before substantive content
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the comment opens with a short, emotionally loaded sentence or fragment working as an attention-grabbing headline, such as a declarative claim of personal harm, moral outrage, or a rhetorical jab, before any substantive policy content. A 10 opens with a clear stand-alone hook line, disconnected from any factual support that immediately follows. A 5 opens with a substantive claim carrying noticeable emotional charge. A 0 opens directly with a substantive claim, fact, or procedural statement.
all_channels.upstream_parent: surface-only

all_channels.name: Litigation-brief posture
all_channels.instruction: Score how far the comment adopts an adversarial legal-brief posture. A 10 reads like a brief: claims of statutory conflict, plain-text mandates, legal jeopardy or formal violations, and explicitly requested legal remedies. A 5 makes one such legal-conflict claim inside otherwise ordinary prose. A 0 has none of that posture. Score the posture itself, not whether the legal claims are correct.
all_channels.upstream_parent: Professional litigation or regulatory-counsel involvement

all_channels.name: Docket-lineage familiarity
all_channels.instruction: Score how much the comment narrates its own prior involvement in this regulatory process. A 10 recounts specific earlier filings, prior amendments, pilot participation, waivers, or agency precedents it took part in. A 5 alludes to past involvement without specifics. A 0 treats the docket as entirely new and references no prior history.
all_channels.upstream_parent: Existing agency relationship and incumbent participation in the docket

all_channels.name: Ties a requested change to a specific paragraph of regulatory text
all_channels.instruction: Score whether a requested change is anchored to identified regulatory text. A 10 states what the comment wants changed and ties that request to a named paragraph, section, or table of the proposed text. A 5 requests a change and identifies only the broad part or topic it falls under. A 0 requests no change, or makes a request that names no provision. Score the anchoring, not the merit of the change requested.

all_channels.name: Unsolicited commendation of agency staff and process
all_channels.instruction: Score how much the comment praises the agency itself, its staff, its effort, its priorities, or the rulemaking process, beyond the pro-forma 'we appreciate the opportunity to comment', which does not count. A 10 explicitly commends the work or the workers ('kudos to the staff', 'thank you for your dedication'). A 5 offers one warm sentence calling the proposal a step in the right direction. A 0 praises the agency nowhere. Do not count praise of the policy goal by third parties.
all_channels.upstream_parent: coaching from an advocacy group or a naive model of how the process works - the submitter believes goodwill is currency here, which tracks submitter type rather than argument strength

all_channels.name: Formal institutional filing apparatus / letterhead conventions
all_channels.instruction: Score the density of formal filing conventions in the text: an addressee block, a 'Re:' caption with docket or RIN number, numbered footnotes describing membership or assets, a formal salutation such as 'Dear Sir or Madam', and a closing signature with a professional title. A 10 has the full apparatus. A 5 has one or two of these conventions. A 0 is plain conversational text with none. These are formatting conventions; score their presence only.
all_channels.upstream_parent: the comment was drafted by professional legal counsel, in-house regulatory/tax staff, or a paid lobbyist following standard formal rulemaking-filing conventions

all_channels.name: Organizational scale self-credentialing
all_channels.instruction: Score how much the comment foregrounds its own organizational scale: quantified membership, customers, assets, market share, national reach, or institutional prestige. A 10 puts such claims front and center, with figures or superlatives. A 5 mentions organizational size once, in passing. A 0 makes no organizational-scale claim. Score the presence and prominence of these claims, never whether they make the argument stronger.
all_channels.upstream_parent: submitter resources, status, and perceived agency importance

all_channels.name: Repeats the same sentence or phrase multiple times
all_channels.instruction: Score verbatim repetition of a sentence or phrase within the comment. A 10 repeats the same sentence or phrase word for word three or more times. A 5 repeats it word for word exactly twice. A 0 contains no verbatim repetition. Score the repetition itself as a surface property of the text.
all_channels.upstream_parent: surface-only

all_channels.name: Mentions the number of members or constituents represented
all_channels.instruction: Score whether the comment states how many members, employees, customers, or constituents the submitter speaks for. A 10 states such a count explicitly. A 0 contains no such count anywhere. Score only the presence of the stated constituency count, never whether it makes the argument stronger.
all_channels.upstream_parent: organisational scale and membership base

all_channels.name: Submission-production residue
all_channels.instruction: Score how much production and ingest residue is visible in the comment text: OCR corruption, duplicated headers, raw email routing lines, attachment placeholders, odd spacing, or extraction errors. A 10 has such artifacts running through the visible text. A 5 has one or two isolated artifacts. A 0 is cleanly presented prose with none. This is a surface property of the text; score the artifacts only.
all_channels.upstream_parent: document-production, scanning, and docket-ingestion pipeline
